title: Residence Remodeling
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY VIENNA
detail_text: This solicitation specification includes the construction of 2 drywall partitions including electrical installations, AC installations, sanitary installations, interior doors, in two USG-owned residences in Vienna, Austria. The work consists of, but is not limited to the following: • New Bedroom 3 area = 13,90 m² • Modified Living/dining/kitchen area = 33,00 m² • Modified kitchen area = 14,00 m² • Modified Bathroom 2 area = 4,74 m² Estimated size of the project according to FAR 36.204 is between $25,000 and $100,000.
